_README: TEMPLATE, NOT THE DEPLOYED ARTIFACT. The live policy on s3://edullm-data-us-east-2 differs
from this file by EXACTLY ONE substitution: <ACCOUNT_ID> -> the real 12-digit account id.
Nothing else differs. The placeholder is here because this is a public repo (CLAUDE.md).
VERIFY THE DEPLOYED POLICY MATCHES THIS TEMPLATE — run this, do not eyeball it.
STEP 1, get the live policy + account id. In an agent session a bare `aws` has NO
credentials (everything goes through the sb-aws broker), so fetch them that way and
paste the JSON into /tmp/live.json. From a normally-configured shell the plain CLI works:
aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket edullm-data-us-east-2 --query Policy --output text \
> /tmp/live.json
aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text          # -> ACCT
STEP 2, compare (ACCT = the 12-digit id from step 1):
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
ACCT='000000000000'   # <-- paste the real id from step 1
live=json.load(open('/tmp/live.json'))
t=json.load(open('infra/09-mirror-bucket-policy.json')); t.pop('_README',None)
t=json.loads(json.dumps(t).replace('<ACCOUNT_ID>',ACCT))
def norm(o):  # S3 collapses single-element lists to bare strings; that is not a drift
if isinstance(o,dict):  return {k:norm(v) for k,v in o.items()}
if isinstance(o,list):  return norm(o[0]) if len(o)==1 else [norm(x) for x in o]
return o
print('MATCH' if norm(live)==norm(t) else 'DRIFT'); assert norm(live)==norm(t)
EOF
VERIFIED 2026-08-08: this comparison returns MATCH against the deployed policy.
The norm() step is required, not a fudge: S3 rewrites a one-element aws:PrincipalArn LIST
into a bare STRING on read-back, so a plain diff reports a false difference on a correct
deployment. A check that cries wolf gets ignored, which defeats the point of having one.
A template nobody diffs against production is how a wheel shipped a Gate A function that
existed in no commit (CLAUDE.md, the 0.5.1 incident). Run the diff, do not assume.
